title: Compact Attestation Flow + Pricing Anchor Experiment for Enterprise Onboarding
creator: Leah Parks
description:
Summary: Some enterprise prospects stall during contract negotiations because completing SIG/CAIQ and bespoke attestations is resource-heavy for both customer and Redwood. This ticket scopes a two-part initiative: (1) a compact, customer-facing attestation 'lite' flow that reduces required evidence to an auditable minimum and produces a signed JSON attestation the customer can attach to procurement; (2) a pricing anchor experiment that offers a small, predictable credit/price-offset when customers complete the lite flow during onboarding, to measure conversion lift and net revenue impact.

Goals: Reduce time-to-SOW, increase contract conversion by 8-12% for mid-market customers, measure cost per converted account, and validate that lightweight attestations don't increase downstream support burden.

Success metrics (primary):
- Conversion lift: +8-12% in signed contracts within 30 days of demo for customers in pilot segments.
- Time-to-complete security questionnaire: median reduction from 18 days to <=5 days.
- Average legal/review touchpoints per deal reduced by 30%.

Secondary metrics:
- Uptake rate of lite-attestation flow among invited prospects > 40%.
- Engineering support tickets related to attestation evidence unchanged or reduced.

Scope:
- In scope: build attestation lite web flow (hosted in console) with templated answers, auto-populated product facts, a signed attestation artifact (RFC-style signed JSON + PDF snapshot), audit trail, telemetry hooks; pricing experiment hookup (coupon/credit issuance and tracking) and measurement dashboard. Implement server-side APIs and backend record-keeping.
- Out of scope: full CAIQ automation for all vendors, bespoke legal negotiations, on-prem install attestation flow in this phase.

Design & UX notes:
- Flow should be 6-8 steps max; emphasize ‘Minimum required evidence’ with inline tooltips.
- Provide 'download package' button that bundles signed attestation + evidence checklist + short explanatory cover letter.
- UX microcopy will include explicit guidance on what the attestation legally represents (not a full warranty). Design to run a short accessibility review.

Experiment design (pricing anchor):
- Hypothesis: Offering a $5k equivalent credit/price-anchor (tiered by ARR) when customers complete the lite-attestation will increase conversion and time-to-sign without materially impacting ACV.
- Groups: randomized controlled trial among eligible mid-market leads (n=240 target). Control: baseline onboarding. Treatment A: lite-attestation only. Treatment B: lite-attestation + price-anchor credit applied on first invoice if contract executed within 60 days.
- Measurement window: 90 days post-experiment enrollment.

Open questions / trade-offs:
- Legal: is the signed attestation acceptable for majority of procurement teams? (Action: Legal to approve attestation template)
- Pricing: fixed credit vs. percentage-of-first-invoice? (We recommend fixed for clarity.)
- Security: what minimum evidence fields must be verified by an engineering reviewer? Could be delegated to Solutions Engineering for validation in pilot.

Risks:
- Customers might treat lite-attestation as full assurance and request additional contractual obligations. Mitigation: clear disclaimers and routing of requests to Legal/SE.
- Attestation fraud or misstatements. Mitigation: require a named signatory and enforce rate limits + post-issuance audit sampling.

Implementation plan (high level):
1) PM/Design: finalize attestation template and UX mockups (owner: Marcus/Design) - due 2025-02-20.
2) Legal/Security: sign-off on language + acceptable evidence list (owner: Legal - Priya Raman) - due 2025-02-28.
3) Engineering: build attestation API, signed artifact generator, console UI, and pricing credit pipeline integration (owner: ENG - team runtime) - sprint 2025-W08.
4) Pilot: internal pilot with 10 existing accounts + 50 new prospects, run experiment A/B/B for 8 weeks.
5) Analyze: product analytics + revenue impact review; recommend gradation or roll-back.

Acceptance criteria:
- Lite flow live in staging and returns signed artifact (JSON + PDF) for 10 test accounts.
- Pricing credit applied correctly in simulated invoices and visible in billing UI.
- Legal has signed off on template and audit process.
- Telemetry emits events for step completion, download, and credit redemption.
